global: This is one fresh native role in a frozen synthetic proposal study. Do not read any other case, role, repository history or canonical skill. Use only the exact payload below. Do not delegate or use internet. Write only the specified output file with exclusive-create mode; never overwrite. Save a substantive artifact body, then return the same body in FINAL (not a save summary). All model statements are predictions under synthetic rival maps, not observed physical or human outcomes. Respect source IDs, uncertainty and fixed valued outcome. Do not name administrative condition labels in the body. Numerical model arithmetic is permitted; external facts and invented resources are not. Word caps count whitespace-delimited words in the saved primary body. If impossible, save the failure and reason rather than repair the protocol.

templates.inversion: Role: shared concern investigator, causal inversion. Maximum 350 words. Reverse the presumed solution-to-benefit arrow; state when increasing the preferred intervention could produce the problem. Keep both supplied rival accounts alive. Provide incompatible predictions, a finite resource-feasible candidate probe with defeat, and outcome/unknowns. Use concern source IDs I1,I2,...; distinguish supplied facts from new proposals. Record operation families, not just labels.
templates.attack: Role: shared concern investigator, dependency attack. Maximum 350 words. Attack the named dependency and record the valued outcome that must survive. Specify what becomes possible from that failure without secretly reinstalling it. Preserve at least two rivals and specify a finite separating probe, available resources, defeat and displaced burden. Use source IDs K1,K2,...; distinguish supplied facts from new proposals. Record operation families.
templates.converger_immediate: Role: converger. Maximum 650 words. Receive the common case and exact two shared concerns. Resolve disagreement immediately into one preferred working account before designing any probe. Record the selection and why; preserve unresolved or rejected source material explicitly with original IDs. A preference is provisional, not discovered truth. Produce an actionable account and candidate test while maintaining valued outcome, feasibility and defeat. Do not fabricate facts.
templates.converger_delayed: Role: converger. Maximum 650 words. Receive the common case and exact two shared concerns. Keep incompatible accounts and their opposing predictions explicit until after a separating probe is designed; only then state any provisional convergence. Preserve unresolved or rejected source material explicitly with original IDs. Produce an actionable finite test while maintaining valued outcome, feasibility and defeat. Do not fabricate facts.
templates.converger_ordinary: Role: ordinary-reasoning relay, first stage. Maximum 650 words. Receive the same common case and exact two shared concerns. Use ordinary direct analytical reasoning to choose a practical next diagnostic step. No special delayed-conflict or residue policy. Preserve uncertainty, source IDs, feasibility, valued outcome and defeat. Record omitted material explicitly.
templates.converger_generic: Role: generic-creativity relay, first stage. Maximum 650 words. Receive the same common case and exact two shared concerns. Generate practical creative diagnostic ideas using broad free association followed by feasibility selection. No special delayed-conflict or residue policy. Preserve uncertainty, source IDs, valued outcome and defeat; record omitted material explicitly.
templates.distill: Role: adapted Distill/summary stage. Maximum 600 words total, each branch maximum 300 words. Receive only the common case and your own converger body. Produce exactly two separate sections `## MAIN` and `## RESIDUE`. MAIN is a clean actionable summary. RESIDUE contains only actually omitted, rejected, or unresolved content traceable to original IDs in the supplied converger; no fabricated residue. Preserve relevant conditions and unknowns. If empty, state empty. Newly proposed operations in this stage must be marked NEW; they are new proposals, not preserved source content. Both sections are saved; only one assigned frozen branch will go to a fresh builder.
templates.distill_relay: Role: ordinary relay summary stage. Maximum 600 words total, each branch maximum 300 words. Receive only common case and own first-stage relay body. Produce exactly `## MAIN` and `## RESIDUE`: MAIN is a direct practical summary for the fresh builder; RESIDUE records omitted/unresolved content with source IDs. No special residue resurrection instruction. Mark any first-appearing proposal NEW. Both saved; only MAIN will be delivered onward.
templates.builder: Role: fresh probe builder. Maximum 500 words. You receive the common case and one frozen supplement, with no upstream bodies or other arms. Propose at most TWO distinct finite separating probes. For each: ID, precise settings/trials and readout, at least two rival predictions, available resource list, clear defeat, fixed outcome/burden, and origin delta relative to the supplement and ordinary archive. A repeat of an upstream/archive operation is a repeat; do not claim novelty by renaming, more precise arithmetic alone, or swapping equivalent parameter values. You may honestly return zero new probes or distinguish useful repeats from new candidates. Primary qualification requires an operation family beyond ordinary archive AND all supplied upstream probe operations. Do not invent model truth or claim measured benefit.
templates.assessor: Role: independent assessment. Maximum 1800 words including JSON. You are unaware of the other assessor. Six anonymous final outputs and their exact assigned supplements, common case/model, exact shared concern archive and ordinary archive are supplied. Administrative method labels/policies are withheld; content may still permit inference. Judge each final output's at most two probes. Return substantive rationale and a final fenced JSON object with schema {"grades":{"X1":{"candidate_count":0,"qualified_family_count":0,"qualified_families":[],"probe_grades":[{"id":"...","family":"...","qualified":false,"reason":"...","prediction_valid":false,"resource_feasible":false,"clear_defeat":false,"upstream_repeat":true,"ordinary_repeat":false,"uncertainty":"..."}]}},"cross_output_equivalences":[],"uncertainties":[]}. Include all X1..X6. Qualified families require concrete DIFFERING predictions from finite supplied models, available resources, clear defeat, maintained outcome, and substantive operational difference from ordinary archive and all supplied upstream probe operations. Count each equivalent family only once within each output; the same family in different outputs may each count for contrasts and must be linked in equivalence notes. Exact prior test with a renamed label or numerical expansion gets zero novelty credit. Preserve partial/invalid candidates, disputes and unknowns. New first-appearing downstream proposals are proposals, never retained source facts. Qualification is proposal specification only; real efficacy/originality unknown.

policy_freeze: Four cases all scheduled; no adaptation from development scores. Actual supplement lengths retained, no forced padding.
